name: Light & Dark Ice
description: Fire ice shots that damage enemies or heal allies.

stats.FIRE RATE: 0.5s for three shots. The interval between the first two shots is 0.05s
stats.DAMAGE FALLOFF: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 75% at 40m

name: Fate of Both Worlds
description: Take center stage and start dancing! Toggle between two performances: Heal allies or grant them Damage Boost.

stats.CASTING: Persistent spell field that surrounds the caster
stats.COOLDOWN: Luna Snow can swap between healing and damage boosting every 0.5s

name: Absolute Zero
description: Cast a clump of ice to Freeze the hit enemy and restore Health. Landing a hit grants Bonus Health.

name: Ice Arts
description: Fire ice shards for a short duration, damaging enemies or healing allies while restoring her own Health.

stats.CASTING: Single-cast spell field that pierces through enemies
stats.RANGE: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 1m and a height of 40m

name: Share the Stage
description: Attach Idol Aura to an ally. Allies with Idol Aura also restore Health when Luna Snow is healing others.

name: Number One Idol
description: Boost Damage and Healing. Gain extra healing when healing others.

name: Cryo Heart
description: Automatically restore Health when casting Ice Arts or Absolute Zero.

name: Smooth Skate
description: Keep moving forward to start ice skating and enable higher jumps.

name: Winter's Chill
description: Luna Snow grants Winter's Chill to Iron Fist and Emma Frost. When Iron Fist activates Harmony Recover, he can heal nearby allies with Lunar Chi. Emma Frost can project ice energy forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies. She can also enhance her diamond form, condensing frost into an Iced Out Diamond barrier that blocks enemy attacks and movement.

name: Spirit Fox Accord
description: White Fox grants Luna Snow a spirit fox for protection. Luna can activate it for a burst of speed and fire it forward, healing allies in its path while applying Charm to enemies.
